fluff.overview: Stalwart Support's heavy LRM platoons carry Federated-Barrett M42B rifles as personal arms and Corean FarShot man-portable long-range missile launchers as their support weapon. This combination gives the platoon engagement capability well beyond normal infantry ranges, allowing them to strike vehicles and fortified positions from distances where return fire from small arms is ineffective. When the Word of Blake absorbed New Canton into the Protectorate in 3067, Stalwart Support turned against their former allies and joined the local resistance. Colonel Sanders' troops applied the same combined-arms tactics they had honed against insurgents, using their LRM and TAG spotter teams to pin and bombard Word of Blake positions. Data recovered from New Canton showed the Word's proclamation of total control in August 3071 was premature. Stalwart Support fought on for another two years before the command was finally destroyed, inflicting losses far beyond what an infantry regiment should have been capable of delivering.
